subject.title: fix(amazon-bedrock): keep blank credentials from overriding AWS auth

question: Should the bundled Bedrock provider be allowed to delete whitespace-only AWS credential variables from the gateway process in order to restore AWS SDK default-chain fallback?
rationale: The failure is real and the branch handles the explicit bearer and skip-auth exceptions, but process-wide environment mutation is an upgrade and interoperability tradeoff that code review cannot safely decide without owner intent.

options.title: Accept the scoped cleanup
options.body: Approve the current behavior because whitespace-only credential values are invalid and the default AWS credential chain must reach profile, SSO, ECS, and IMDS sources.

options.title: Require a scoped resolver
options.body: Pause for a design that bypasses malformed environment credentials without mutating process-wide state, if a supported AWS SDK seam can preserve equivalent fallback behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped cleanup
recommendation.body: Approve the current behavior because whitespace-only credential values are invalid and the default AWS credential chain must reach profile, SSO, ECS, and IMDS sources.

likelyOwner.reason: Likely low-confidence routing candidate for a bundled-provider compatibility decision.
